import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Delete old log and restart fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm /root/.pm2/logs/areloria-error.log; pm2 restart areloria 2>&1 | tail -2")

import time
time.sleep(15)

# Check early errors
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -30 /root/.pm2/logs/areloria-error.log 2>&1")
print("First errors:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
